name: Relevance
description: The extent to which the response is relevant to the context and the previous conversation.

name: Engagement
description: The degree to which the response promotes further conversation and interaction.

name: Creativity
description: The originality and uniqueness of the response, including the use of interesting facts or anecdotes.

name: Coherence
description: The logical flow and clarity of the response, ensuring it makes sense within the conversation.

name: Accuracy
description: The factual accuracy of the response, including the correct use of information and details.
